## TASK-031 - Verify fresh and preserved neutral installation routes

Exercise the delivered Template and initializer in disposable depot/project fixtures for fresh create, first preparation, manual Template copy and preserved customized/capture-off/disabled configurations.

### Risks

- Tests use disposable registered roots rather than creating unrequested real products.

### Acceptance criteria

- Each route has its own correct identity, full local capability/contracts and truthful static readiness with optional runtime unselected/not exercised.
- No environments, models, history, derived data, certification, bootstrap or session credentials are inherited.
- Custom assets, licenses, earlier receipts, capture-off and disabled choices are preserved or produce explicit conflicts; real registry/product state remains untouched.

### Planned verification

- Run create/prepare-existing/manual-copy scenarios through delivered entry points in disposable depots.
- Inspect exact inventories, identity/binding, reports and no-install evidence; compare all preserved fixture artifacts.

### Risks

- Root runtime availability must not be silently assumed for a neutral starter.

### Acceptance criteria

- All required baseline ontology test identities and new corrective controls pass without audit wrappers/import patches or unexpected selected-profile skips.
- The actual semantic acceptance test runs with SYS4AI_SEMANTIC_ACCEPTANCE_ROOT; guard prerequisites use documented selection and no implicit installation.
- Full populated SHACL completes in the supported finite budget; actual runtime results are distinguished from neutral static checks and synthetic fixture ownership.

### Planned verification

- Run PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s .agents/skills/ontology/tests -v from root with documented selections.
- Run the same delivered entry point in initialized/relocated fixtures and apply the test-identity/skip gate.
- Capture exact commands, roots, helpers/profile/model versions, triple counts, timing and process exit/cleanup.

### Risks

- A source-only recovery test does not establish delivered helper behavior.

### Acceptance criteria

- Earlier base editions/provenance remain stable during selected capability adoption/refresh and equivalent reruns add no duplicate registrations, records or side effects.
- Interruption resumes the exact intent only; changed source, conflicting target and unknown owner refuse replay and report the actual partial boundary.
- Final dependency health is freshly checked; stale prior readiness cannot survive relevant input changes.

### Planned verification

- Run delivered initializer and selected maintenance/startup recovery controls at meaningful interruption points.
- Compare before/after identities, preferences, histories and customized package bytes and inspect pending-state reporting.
